reliefs.reasoning: Respondents failed to complete the flats due to discontinuance of their business as developer (abandonment of project), making them liable to refund the amount with interest under Section 18(1)(b) of RERA.
Complainants are entitled to Rs. 10,000/- towards the cost of their complaints.

supplementary_proceedings.reasoning: Complainants filed applications reporting non-compliance of final orders. Respondents appeared through Adv. The bench found the reason for non-compliance unappealing as respondents had prior opportunity and other sources. Recovery warrant issued under Section 40(1) of RERA.

extraction_notes: The primary order (Final Order, dated 2018-10-31) addresses four specific complaints. The supplementary proceeding (Order on Recovery Applications, dated 2020-11-02) addresses five complaints, including the four from the primary order plus two additional ones (CC006000000056077 and CC006000000056602). The total unique complainant count across both parts of the document is 9. The interest rate of 10.55% p.a. is explicitly stated in the primary order (point 6a) and is derived from '2% above SBI's highest MCLR which is currently 8.55%' (point 5).
